top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §744.3503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no recent fire inspection accessible for review.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have a current health inspection for licensing to view.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver lacked an affidavit- Form 2912 - in their documentation.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pediatric First Aid (26 TAC §744.1301(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 staff file did not include a first aid training certificate.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1301(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two staff records reviewed did not have completed CPR/First aid training.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.
